title: stegostyla atrata
intro: Stegostyla atrata, commonly known as the African star apple, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. The African star apple has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stegostyla atrata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit potential in treating various health conditions.
